name: rayvoice
title: RayVoice
description: Turn your latest clipboarded text into an audio podcast with ElevenLabs Eleven v4 TTS. Single-voice narration + two-host dialogue.
author: francesco_oddo

commands.name: clipboard-speech
commands.title: Speak Clipboard as Podcast
commands.description: Read clipboard text aloud with ElevenLabs Eleven v4 (single voice). Saves MP3 and auto-plays.

commands.name: clipboard-podcast
commands.title: Clipboard to 2-Host Podcast
commands.description: Turn clipboard text into a two-host podcast dialogue with ElevenLabs Text-to-Dialogue (Eleven v4).

commands.name: intro
commands.title: Play Welcome Intro
commands.description: Hear a short predefined RayVoice tour. No clipboard needed — great for testing your setup.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: ElevenLabs API Key
preferences.description: Get one at https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys (free tier includes ~10 min/mo).

preferences.name: voiceId
preferences.title: Voice ID (Host 1 / Narrator)
preferences.description: Voice ID from elevenlabs.io/app/voice-library. Default is Rachel.

preferences.name: voiceId2
preferences.title: Voice ID (Host 2, dialogue only)
preferences.description: Second voice for the 2-host podcast command. Default is George.

preferences.name: modelId
preferences.title: ElevenLabs Model
preferences.description: Turbo is ~10x faster with the same expressiveness. v4 max quality, Flash fastest/cheapest.

preferences.name: outputFormat
preferences.title: Audio Format
preferences.description: MP3 128kbps works everywhere. Lower bitrates save credits/bandwidth slightly.

preferences.name: autoPlay
preferences.title: Playback
preferences.description: Auto-play the MP3 after generating it.
preferences.label: Auto-play audio
